selection: Use DWQ for the small matched M4 gate only if it solves at least as many tasks as the current C rerun, with fewer completion tokens and less total generation time; otherwise test C. This is hardware selection, not release promotion. Worsened DWQ validation remains a release concern.
protocol: Existing benchmark.py, one warmup plus three measured trials, 256 output tokens, greedy seed 0, prefill 512, 1024/4096/16384 prompt tokens. Sequential models and no competing transfers or GPU work.
workload: Codex editor with convert.py and refine_dwq.py open; convert.py active, idle; no typing or builds. Other desktop applications preserved. Whole-system counters every two seconds; MLX allocator memory recorded separately.
